title: Open, Closed, In, Out
label: ch:ml-open-closed
canDo: I can open and close a door, ask somebody else to, and say which side of it I am on.

payoff.summary: From cold: the two verbs, the asking ending they share with the first commands, and the pair a doorway divides.
payoff.note: Four atoms, four lessons. The chapter buys FOUR verb forms for TWO words: the asking ending is the long uu already owned from keLkkoo in the first commands, and the three tense endings come from a verb learned long before. vaathil was named in chapter 52 and nothing could be done to it or about it until now.
